aboutGame.title: What is In Falsus?
paragraphs: In Falsus is a stylish rhythm and card integration adventure developed by lowiro. Guide five high school students across a mysterious world collared beneath a long shadow, battling through dynamic musical encounters while unraveling deep narrative mysteries.

Blend lightning-fast keyboard and mouse rhythm gameplay with strategic deckbuilding. Craft Iota traits onto Hex Board blueprints, conquer four distinct difficulty tiers from Minimal to Forbidden, and master complex mechanics including TAP, HOLD, FIELD tracking, and directional FLICK notes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about In Falsus.

items.question: What is In Falsus?
items.answer: In Falsus is a dark fantasy rhythm and card integration adventure developed by lowiro. It blends fast-paced 4K to 6K+ keyboard and mouse rhythm action with strategic Hex Board deckbuilding, following five students unraveling mysteries across a fractured world.

items.question: What platforms is In Falsus available on?
items.answer: In Falsus is officially available on PC via Steam. Players on macOS or handheld devices can run the game using compatible compatibility layers with proper audio latency tuning.

items.question: How does the card integration mechanic work in In Falsus?
items.answer: In Falsus features a unique Hex Board card system where players insert Iota chips into blueprints to boost Power, Defense, and Resolve. Avoiding penalties like Overload or Disconnect ensures maximum stat output during song battles.

items.question: What difficulty levels are available in In Falsus?
items.answer: In Falsus offers four difficulty tiers: Minimal (MIN 4K), Evolved (EVO 5K), Ultimate (ULT 6K), and Forbidden (FBD 6K+ with wide notes and high density), catering to both newcomers and hardcore rhythm veterans.

items.question: Are there active redeem codes in In Falsus?
items.answer: In Falsus is a premium standalone PC game on Steam and does not currently use a code redemption system. Any future promotional events or official bonuses will be featured in our updates guide.
